end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting wet waste into the green bin and dry waste into the blue bin. They correctly identified mango peels, leftover food, vegetable peels and dry leaves as wet waste, and paper towel as dry waste. Anika first included wrappers and plastic in compost, then corrected this to the blue bin later in the lesson. At home, sort a few household items together and ask whether each can rot or stays dry.
